jobs.title: Product Manager, Stocks
jobs.description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help build and scale our Stocks product. This role sits at the intersection of consumer fintech, capital markets, and digital assets, and is an opportunity to shape how users access and interact with stocks and other real-world assets onchain.

You’ll own the development and growth of the product across the full lifecycle—from defining the strategy and roadmap to designing the user experience, navigating market structure and operational constraints, and shipping products to market. A core part of the role will be making the complexity of capital markets and blockchain infrastructure feel simple and intuitive for users.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, legal, compliance, operations, and business teams to bring products to market and help define what the next generation of onchain investing looks like.

Responsibilities

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Ondo’s stocks product.

- Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and translate them into simple, intuitive product experiences.

- Lead products from concept through launch and iteration, defining requirements, prioritizing features, and making thoughtful tradeoffs along the way.

- Design experiences that abstract away the complexity of brokerage, trading, settlement, and blockchain infrastructure for users.

- Partner closely with engineering and design to build high-quality consumer products.

- Work cross-functionally with legal, compliance, operations, and business teams to navigate the unique requirements of bringing traditional financial assets onchain.

- Develop a detailed understanding of market structure, trading workflows, liquidity, and the competitive landscape across both traditional finance and crypto.

- Use customer insights, product data, and market developments to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

- Help define Ondo’s longer-term product vision for how stocks and other real-world assets can exist and trade onchain.

Requirements

- 5+ years of product management experience building and shipping consumer-facing financial products.

- Strong understanding of capital markets and market structure, including how trading, order books, execution, and brokerage workflows operate.

- Deep expertise in securities market infrastructure, including a thorough understanding of clearing and settlement ecosystems and the operational mechanics of stock trading lifecycles.

- Strong command of the regulatory landscape and compliance frameworks for securities trading, with the ability to partner effectively with Legal and Compliance teams..

- Strong consumer product instincts, with the ability to turn complex financial concepts and infrastructure into intuitive user experiences.

- Experience working in a strong product culture and partnering closely with engineering and design to ship high-quality products.

- Genuine, hands-on experience using crypto and DeFi products. You should be an active user of the ecosystem, not simply interested in the space.

- Strong analytical and product judgment, with the ability to prioritize effectively and make decisions in ambiguous environments.

- Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- High degree of curiosity and an ability to quickly develop expertise across unfamiliar or rapidly evolving areas.

Nice to have

- Experience building products at a brokerage, investing platform, trading application, neobroker, neobank, fintech, or crypto company.

- Experience working directly on retail investing, equities, brokerage, or trading products.

- Professional experience in crypto or digital assets.

- Experience with real-world assets (RWAs), tokenization, or bringing traditional financial products onchain.

- Familiarity with DeFi market structure, decentralized exchanges, liquidity, and onchain trading.

- Experience working on products that span both traditional financial infrastructure and blockchain-based systems.

What we offer

- Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation

- Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)

- Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices

- A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom

- Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to oversee a portfolio of products within the Ondo platform — spanning tokenized equities, fixed income, and investment strategies. You will own product lines end to end: setting direction, translating market and customer needs into clear product proposals, and driving execution across Engineering, Design, BD, Strategy, and Operations. This role sits at the intersection of capital markets and blockchain infrastructure — you will need to understand both the financial products you are building and the technical systems that power them. The ideal candidate brings genuine care for the product, deep familiarity with capital markets structure and participants, and the ability to move fast without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

- Own one or more product lines within the Ondo platform (e.g., tokenized equities, treasuries, or investment strategies), driving roadmap prioritization and delivery end to end

- Lead customer and partner discovery to surface high-value opportunities across tokenized securities, structured products, and related asset classes

- Translate ambiguous market and stakeholder needs into structured PRDs with clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics

- Assess feasibility and complexity of new features and product lines in collaboration with Engineering and Solutions Engineering

- Build business cases rooted in ROI, risk, and strategic alignment, and secure cross-functional buy-in for go decisions

- Represent Ondo credibly with external stakeholders — institutional partners, issuers, distributors — and serve as the product point of contact in those discussions

- Define delivery milestones, manage execution to production, and instrument post-launch reviews to iterate based on results

- Maintain a prioritized pipeline of product opportunities that continuously feeds the roadmap

- Contribute to overall product strategy by bringing capital markets insight, competitive analysis, and ecosystem signal to internal discussions

Requirements

- 5+ years of full-time product management or founder experience, including end-to-end ownership of shipped products

- Meaningful exposure to capital markets — equities, fixed income, funds, or structured products — whether through TradFi roles, fintech, or working closely with institutional clients and partners

- Prior experience in a blockchain or crypto-native environment, or working on tokenization, digital assets, or DeFi products

- Understanding of how financial products are structured, distributed, and regulated, and the ability to engage credibly with institutional counterparties

- Strong customer research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods, with the ability to turn insights into crisp product decisions

- Proven track record turning ambiguous requirements into shipped products with measurable outcomes

- Excellent communication skills for both external and internal audiences, including logical writing and executive-ready documentation

- Solid analytical skills and comfort defining success metrics and using data to guide prioritization and iteration

- High ownership, strong organizational discipline, and the ability to operate in fast-paced and ambiguous environments

- Based in PT, MT, CT, or ET time zones

Nice to have

- Experience working alongside Business Development, Partnerships, or Sales on product-adjacent initiatives

- Familiarity with brokerage, exchange, or market-making operations and the systems that support them

- Exposure to frontend or UX practices sufficient to collaborate effectively with designers and engineers

What we offer

- Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation

- Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)

- Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices

- A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom

- Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a Growth PM to own user-facing product strategy across our unified platform interface, Ondo Finance App. This role is the growth counterpart to our platform PMs — and will be the primary driver of user acquisition, activation, and retention across Ondo's expanding product suite (Stocks, Treasuries, Portfolios, and more).

You will work at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and marketing to build world-class user journeys for a new generation of on-chain financial products.

What You'll Own

- User acquisition: Identify and build product-led growth loops, referral mechanisms, onboarding flows, and entry points that bring new users into the Ondo ecosystem

- Activation: Design and optimize the end-to-end onboarding experience — from first visit to first meaningful transaction — across Ondo Finance Web App and eventually mobile

- Retention & engagement: Build features and feedback loops that keep users active, informed, and deepening their relationship with Ondo's product lines

- User journey design: Map and continuously improve user journeys across all Ondo products surfaced through Ondo Finance Web App

- Experimentation: Drive a structured A/B testing and experimentation culture; define success metrics and own the growth analytics stack alongside data and engineering

- Cross-product growth: Collaborate with product line PMs to ensure growth initiatives are coordinated and reinforced across product surfaces

Requirements

- 4–7+ years of product management experience with a clear focus on consumer-facing or growth-oriented products

- Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products — particularly products involving real-world assets, trading, or investment platforms

- Personal experience using financial products similar to ours, with a genuine desire to walk in the customer's shoes

- Demonstrated track record of owning and improving acquisition, activation, and/or retention metrics at scale

- Strong product instincts — you care deeply about user experience and are willing to do whatever it takes to make the product successful

- Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write sharp, well-reasoned PRDs and present clearly to engineers and leadership

- Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience defining KPIs, running experiments, and translating data into product decisions

- US-hours based (preference per current team structure)

Nice to have

- Familiarity with on-chain / Web3 user onboarding challenges (wallet setup, KYC flows, etc.)

- Experience working on a unified platform serving multiple financial product lines

- Prior exposure to developer-facing or API-adjacent products

What we offer

- Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation

- Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)

- Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices

- A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
